text: 金十数据8月13日讯，京东物流(02618.HK)公告，2026年上半年，总收入达人民币1,247亿元，同比增长26.5%；其中来自外部客户的收入为人民币854亿元，同比增长29.3%。主要业务板块呈现出强劲且稳健的增长趋势。2026年上半年，利润及非国际财务报告准则利润分别达人民币33亿元及人民币37亿元，分别同比增长10.5%及10.7%；其中，毛利达111亿元，同比增长24.8%。
text_en: Jin10 Data, August 13: JD Logistics (02618.HK) announced that in the first half of 2026, total revenue reached RMB 124.7 billion, up 26.5% year-on-year; of which revenue from external customers was RMB 85.4 billion, up 29.3% year-on-year. Major business segments showed strong and steady growth trends. In the first half of 2026, profit and non-IFRS profit reached RMB 3.3 billion and RMB 3.7 billion respectively, up 10.5% and 10.7% year-on-year respectively; of which gross profit reached RMB 11.1 billion, up 24.8%.
